summary: A Hamas bomb exploded on the Israeli side of the 'Yellow Line' in the northern Gaza Strip, prompting IDF retaliatory strikes, while alarms sounded at IDF positions in southern Lebanon amid explosions in Barashit and Bani Huyan. Iran's Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf declared victory in the recent war, and Trump stated the US does not seek to extend the understanding with Iran while maintaining that Iran must never hold nuclear weapons. The Peace Council confirmed no IDF redeployment in Gaza until Hamas fully disarms.
key_points: A Hamas bomb exploded on the Israeli side of the 'Yellow Line' in northern Gaza overnight; IDF carried out strikes in the area afterward, reporting no injuries to Israeli forces. (Source: @manniefabian/58982)

Artillery shelling targeted Zawtar al-Sharqiyah in southern Lebanon amid heightened alert with warplanes flying toward the south. (Source: @redlinkleb/37070, @redlinkleb/37057)

sections.executive_summary: A Hamas bomb detonated on the Israeli side of the 'Yellow Line' in northern Gaza, triggering IDF retaliatory strikes with no Israeli casualties reported. In southern Lebanon, alarms sounded at IDF positions while explosions were reported in Barashit and Bani Huyan, and artillery shelling targeted Zawtar al-Sharqiyah. Iran's Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf declared victory in the recent war against the US and Israel, while Trump stated the US does not seek to extend the understanding with Iran and insists Iran must never obtain nuclear weapons.

points: Iran's Parliament Speaker Mohammad Bagher Ghalibaf described the Iran-US agreement as a 'document of pride and victory in diplomacy' and stated that the US and Israel achieved none of their objectives in the recent war, declaring 'we won this war.' He provided no specific details on which objectives Washington and Jerusalem failed to achieve. (Source: @VahidOnline/77911)

Trump stated that the US does not seek to extend the understanding with Iran, and separately emphasized that Iran must never be allowed to hold nuclear weapons under any circumstances, form, or manner. (Source: @rasedal3ado138e/385322, @asafroz/52515)
Trump threatened to bomb Oman amid ongoing talks between Muscat and Tehran over the Strait of Hormuz, raising regional tensions over the critical waterway. (Source: @presstv/203147)
Mashhad residents gathered to commemorate Iran's martyred Leader Ayatollah Seyyed Ali Khamenei 40 days after his funeral and burial. (Source: @presstv/203146)

Tehran's prosecutor announced intensified enforcement related to hijab and cyberspace, including a 'special moral security prosecutor's office' with 12 judges and a unit for continuous monitoring of cyberspace, amid reports of renewed internet disruptions in Iran. (Source: @mamlekate/104170)

A Qatar army colonel stated in an interview with Al Jazeera that Iranian captive pilots were interrogated, contradicting the Qatari government's denial of capturing Iranian pilots. (Source: @kianmeli1/90903)
An IRGC-affiliated media documentary was assessed to be largely archival footage that was censored or manipulated to appear new, according to geospatial analysis. (Source: @shin_persian/8984)

The IDF reported that a Hamas bomb exploded on the Israeli side of the 'Yellow Line' in the northern Gaza Strip overnight, with terror operatives also opening fire in the area. The incident occurred in an area where an anti-Hamas militia is based. No Israeli forces were injured, and the IDF immediately carried out strikes in the area, calling it a violation of the ceasefire by Hamas. (Source: @manniefabian/58982)

The Peace Council confirmed that no IDF redeployment in the Gaza Strip will occur until Hamas fully disarms all light and heavy weapons and all tunnels are dismantled. Israel retains full self-defense rights if Hamas returns to terrorism, violence, or attempts to rearm. The Prime Minister confirmed Israel will fulfill its previous commitments that helped the US secure the release of all hostages. (Source: @almogboker78/17979)

An Israeli Air Force major faces a hearing prior to indictment for breach of trust, suspected of betting on Polymarket on the dates of IDF strikes in Iran and Yemen. A separate officer charged in February with selling classified intel claimed 'the entire Air Force is involved in gambling.' (Source: @pkpoi/143622, @Faytuks_Network/6343)

Netanyahu posted a Likud campaign image on X showing Zohran Mamdani, Naim Qassem, Mojtaba Khamenei, and Erdogan, with text reading 'This time Netanyahu will not be saved and we will not allow him to win.' (Source: @VahidOnline/77915)

Observation soldiers identified suspects digging a shaft near the separation fence in the Qalandiya area. Forces arriving at the scene encountered fleeing suspects; one was arrested after a foot chase. Excavation tools and buckets were found, and the arrested suspect claimed the intent was to dig a tunnel for infiltration into Israel. (Source: @pkpoi/143624)

Two children were evacuated to Hadassah Ein Karem hospital with severe bodily injuries; resuscitation was performed on one, and the other was in serious condition but conscious. (Source: @yediotnews25/134029)

sections.threat_assessment: The Hamas bomb explosion on the Israeli side of the 'Yellow Line' in northern Gaza represents a direct ceasefire violation that triggered immediate IDF retaliatory strikes, indicating active Hamas operational capability persists despite disarmament commitments. In southern Lebanon, simultaneous alarms at IDF positions, explosions in Barashit and Bani Huyan, and artillery shelling of Zawtar al-Sharqiyah suggest sustained low-intensity hostilities along the Israel-Lebanon border. The discovery of suspects digging an infiltration tunnel near Qalandiya indicates potential expansion of tunnel-based threats to the Jerusalem perimeter, mirroring Gaza-style tactics.
sections.regional_response: Iran's Parliament Speaker Ghalibaf's declaration of victory and Trump's statement against extending the understanding with Iran signal divergent post-war narratives that could complicate diplomatic stabilization. Trump's threat to bomb Oman over Strait of Hormuz talks with Iran introduces a new escalation vector, while the Iraqi PM's report that the Strait's closure severely reduced oil exports underscores the economic stakes for regional actors. China's Xi Jinping planned September 24 meeting with Trump, with Iran and the Strait of Hormuz on the agenda, suggests major-power diplomatic engagement on the crisis.
sections.intelligence_notes: The IAF major's betting on Polymarket about IDF strike dates in Iran and Yemen represents a significant operational security breach, compounded by a separate officer's claim that the entire Air Force is involved in gambling. The IRGC-affiliated documentary using manipulated archival footage to appear new suggests an information operations campaign to shape domestic and regional perceptions. Qatar's army colonel publicly confirming interrogation of Iranian pilots contradicts official Qatari denials, potentially indicating a rift in Gulf-Iran relations or internal Qatari political dynamics.
